best_idea: A room's population is set by how many players are in the zone (ceil of players over a group size, floored at 1), topped up once a second, and a room opens only when the previous room's mobs are all dead.
decision_why: Keep the population formula and the gate-on-clear shape; change to presence-gated population, despawn on empty with a grace timer (row 23), and kills from the server ledger, not the object Deleted flag.
acceptance: Server test: 0 players in zone gives population 0 after the grace timer; 1-5 players gives 1, 6 gives 2; when every listed creature is a server-verified kill the room completes and the next opens; a full loop resets every room to closed before room 1 reopens.
